name: Design and the built environment
question: What does design and the built environment establish about this subject, divided by the aspect of a designed arrangement for human use?
scqa_question: By what dimension can each design claim be placed once?
look_for: DE.O.A1 Use and need
DE.O.A2 Form
DE.O.A3 Performance in use
DE.O.A4 Place and settlement
DE.O.A5 Life of the built thing
rules_of_thumb: Form follows function (CONTESTED as a rule)
collisions: Place by the aspect of the arrangement for use.
Structural and system adequacy is EN; use, form and place are DE.
A verdict on beauty with a stated criterion is AR; design rationale is DE.
Planning law is LA; the planning decision is PO; land price is EC.
open: DE as a pyramid rather than an EN bridge (alternative: EN.O.A2.4 plus AR); form-follows-function.

name: Use and need
question: What need does the arrangement serve?
look_for: Users and activities — who will use it and how. Human factors cite MS.
The brief — the stated programme of needs (W12 once agreed).
Accessibility and universal design — designing for the widest range of users.

name: Form
question: What form, and why?
look_for: Spatial organisation — plan, section, circulation.
Typology — building and product types.
Visual and material language — composition, colour, materials. An aesthetic verdict with a stated criterion is AR.O.A5.

name: Performance in use
question: What does this subject show about performance in use?
look_for: Comfort and indoor environment — thermal, acoustic, daylight. The physics is PH; structural adequacy is EN.
Wayfinding and usability.
Safety in use — building codes are W12; their legal force is LA.
Post-occupancy evaluation — measured performance after use begins (W4).

name: Place and settlement
question: What does this subject show about place and settlement, and what would settle it?
look_for: Site — the physical site claim uses EA.
Urban form — density, street networks, mixed use.
Landscape architecture.
Planning — zoning and land use. The legal instrument is LA; the political decision is PO.

name: Life of the built thing
question: What does this subject show about life of the built thing?
look_for: Maintenance and adaptive reuse.
Sustainability — embodied and operational carbon. The environmental impact claim is EV.
Conservation of built heritage — the heritage meaning is HI.O.A5.3.
